summary: This video breaks down the Sep 1 patch changes to the Temporal Vortex Cloudtop Arbor (Arbor Hydra Noctuaa / Diurna) boss fight. The update added a blocked tile to prevent manual egg manipulation and reduced the number of eggs spawned during the boss's weakened phase from 4 to 3. This resulted in a massive damage nerf to AoE-focused teams, especially Toxin (Serpentemis) teams whose damage fell by nearly 50%. Skratch tests optimal board positioning to salvage Toxin DPS and covers strategy tips for the Bloom & Bounty event.

meta_changes: Temporal Vortex Noctuaa blocked a key grid tile next to the boss head, disabling the strategy of forcing eggs to spawn tightly grouped together.
Arbor Hydra Noctuaa now spawns 3 eggs instead of 4 while under vulnerable penalty states, significantly reducing total AoE damage output for all teams.
tips: In the Bloom & Bounty event, allow Exotic Blooms to complete their entire 10-hour growth cycle to reach maturity before harvesting to maximize Mythic gear drop rates.
Reposition heroes in a straight grid line in Temporal Vortex Noctuaa to maximize AoE damage coverage across the newly spaced-out egg spawns.
